mostWorthwhile.text: Chilling the carrier and its transfer buffer was the most worthwhile action: it showed how the core could stay cold during the handoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the case at the bench was a straightforward preparation with little to discover on its own.

surprise.text: The carrier had to be chilled before the core was moved, and its buffer then bridged the transfer to flight cooling.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though after the initial placement choice each step offered only one gameplay combination.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the receiving laboratory learns from the intact core and its surrounding layer.
